sources.title: Marcel Telles profile within Brazilian wealth article
sources.findings: Birth 23 February 1950; economics study at UFRJ; joined Garantia in 1972.
sources.caution: Read Telles paragraph, not adopt stale rankings or simplify collective brewery transactions into sole personal purchases.

sources.title: 2012 prospectus director biography
sources.findings: Brahma CEO 1989–1999; Burger King Worldwide and Holdings director since October 2010; founding principal partner of 3G.
sources.caution: Targeted biography only; 2012 current offices not current 2026. Incidental AmBev 2002 wording not used as merger chronology.

sources.title: Firm overview
sources.findings: Firm founded 2004 from investment office of Lemann, Sicupira and Telles; current leadership Alex Behring and Daniel Schwartz.
sources.caution: Founder is not sole founder or current co-managing partner; no personal ownership of every portfolio company assumed.

sources.title: 2020 annual report governance statement
sources.findings: Remuneration footnote explicitly dates end of Telles board mandate to 3 June 2020.
sources.caution: Read targeted AGM and footnote passages, not full report. Reject raw current-director claim and secondary 2019 departure claim.

sources.publisher: AB InBev / Bolsa Mexicana de Valores
sources.title: 28 December 2023 transparency disclosure
sources.findings: Transaction 15 December; notification 21 December; publication 28 December. Gift to son Max replaces father as joint ultimate controller of BRC.
sources.caution: Read opening and voting table; not every annex. Does not transfer all AB InBev shares, all family assets or all corporate offices. Avoid group share percentage as personal stake.

sources.title: 2004 Ismart membership article
sources.findings: Ismart established 1999 to support education access for lower-income young people.
sources.caution: Historical program description; not current participant counts or independent causal impact evaluation.

sources.title: Transformações no ethos de elites econômicas
sources.findings: Targeted passage attributes Ismart founding in 1999 to Marcel Telles and Estudar cofounding in 1991.
sources.caution: Read organizational-history paragraphs, not full study or linked original records; program mission not demonstrated social impact.

sources.title: 25 June 2026 shareholder response on Americanas
sources.findings: Reports statement issued through LTS on behalf of Lemann, Telles and Sicupira promising cooperation and stating former executives misled them.
sources.caution: Attributed defense, not judicial finding of innocence or guilt. Targets named in report are not automatically Telles. No court file or direct interview reviewed.

sources.title: June 2026 B55 conference announcement
sources.findings: Announces proposed September 29–30 participation by three founders.
sources.caution: Announcement only, not proof of completed appearance. Search hit presented as LinkedIn recap opened unrelated registry; do not treat that mismatch as attendance evidence.
